title: Travel rules - federal, state and foreign boundaries
facts: TSA aviation security, CBP entry and customs, U.S. passports and federal immigration are federal matters.
Driver-license validity, vehicle insurance and many road-travel requirements are governed by state law.
Entry requirements, visas, medication restrictions and passport-validity rules imposed by another country are foreign-law requirements rather than U.S. federal rules.
Hanka should identify the destination, citizenship or immigration status and mode of travel before giving a specific international-travel document answer.
